title.narrative: Multi-Purpose Cash assistance for Vulnerable Palestine Refugees

description.narrative: ltpgtThe proposed project is framed in the plans and assumption of UNRWA’s “syria, lebanon and jordan emergency appeal 2024” (EA 2024) which aims at helping Palestine refugees meet their life-saving food and NFI needs. The objective is achieved through the provision of unrestricted cash assistance for Palestine refugees in Syria.ltbrgtIn order to ensure optimal utilization of the financial resources, UNRWA introduced a two-tier approach for cash assistance with a focus on the most vulnerable categories of Palestine refugees. The most vulnerable categories of Palestine refugees including (a) families headed by a person older than 60 years old (b) families that include a person with disabilities (c) families headed by a female and (d) orphans.ltbrgtThe estimated 438,000 Palestine Refugees now living in Syria, who were already amongst the most vulnerable groups in the country, are continuously pushed further into vulnerability and poverty and remain highly dependent on the assistance provided by UNRWA to meet their basic needs. ltbrgtAccording to UNRWA estimates, about 40% of the Palestine refugee population in Syria remain in protracted displacement. According to the last UNRWA Post Distribution Monitoring (March 2024), the majority (62%) are food insecure among them 32% severely food insecure, a substantial deterioration from 2023. 41% of assessed households showed crisis to emergency livelihoods coping strategies in March 2024, a 1% increase from September 2023 and 5% increase compared to the previous 12 months.ltbrgtIn 2024, UNRWA is planning to provide cash assistance to 420,000 eligible Palestine refugees, including 155,500 Palestine refugees categorized as most vulnerable using two-tier targeting approach. ltbrgtUNRWA has determined the value of its cash transfers under EA 2024 based on the analysis of socio-economic hardship of our beneficiaries (USD 40.56 per person per month for the most vulnerable Palestine refugees and USD 29.84 per person per month for other vulnerable Palestine refugees, in line with the standard transfer value recommended by Cash Working Group in Syria. With the available financial resources, however, UNRWA plans to provide most vulnerable Palestine refugees with USD 15 per person per month, while other vulnerable Palestine refugees will receive USD 11 per person per month. Through its partners, comprising a network of banks and private companies present in all regions of Syria, the Agency will continue to provide cash assistance in a flexible and timely manner with minimal financial risk. UNRWA plans to conduct 4 rounds of cash distribution in 2024 (3 months / round). lt/pgtltpgtAt the beginning of each distribution round, UNRWA establishes lists of beneficiaries for each cash distribution outlet, which covers the existing caseload and new applicants. Beneficiaries are informed of the date and place of distribution rounds by SMS as well as through popular social networks such as Facebook and posting on lists and information at the different offices of UNRWA in the areas. The list of recipients of assistance is shared with UNRWA’s distribution partners (banks, money vendors). Recipients are checked against the list and have to present proof of identification to receive the assistance. ltbrgtUNRWA plans to conduct two post distribution monitoring (PDM) surveys in 2024. The Agency upholds a complaint and feedback mechanism, which enables refugees to have their amount of assistance reviewed, should they feel the amount of assistance granted is not correct.lt/pgtltpgtThe generous contribution from OCHA will be part of the regular cash assistance programme of UNRWA in 2024: UNRWA has already delivered 4 months of cash assistance for 414,673 Palestine Refugees (including 157,119 most vulnerable) and is working to secure the funds for the next round. OCHA contribution will be used in conjunction with other funds to support 13,090 most vulnerable Palestine Refugees living in Duma, Busra Esh-Sham and Babella for two months. ltbrgtlt/pgt
